title: VA-04: GAO-25-107398 Recommendation 4 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-25-107398 Recommendation 4 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: Spring 2026 update pending.
Response artifact: VA 180-day response letter. The current GAO page still says the letter was expected in spring 2026 and contains no later response or implementation artifact.
Artifact availability: Not reflected on the current GAO page.
Named milestone: Spring 2026; milestone state: Elapsed; no response reflected.
GAO review state: Response pending on official record.
Remaining gap: Category-specific savings and cost-avoidance goals with tracked progress.

Continuation rule: Recheck when the official GAO page posts the response or implementation evidence. Preserve VA-04 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves VA-04 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
